title: Diffusion-Based Stochastic Operator Networks for Uncertainty Quantification in Stochastic Partial Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2605.17107v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce a novel framework for uncertainty quantification of solution operators associated with stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs). Although SPDEs play a central role in modeling complex physical systems under uncertainty, their practical use typically requires specifying the magnitude and structure of model uncertainties that are often unknown and difficult to infer from noisy measurements. To address this challenge, we develop a stochastic operator-learning framework that learns directly from noisy data and outputs both a mean solution field and a quantification of uncertainty. The proposed method, namely the Stochastic Operator Network (SON), is constructed by combining the structure of the Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) with Stochastic Neural Networks (SNNs) to model stochasticity and enable probabilistic prediction. translated_title: 基于扩散模型的随机算子网络用于随机偏微分方程的不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 我们引入了一个新颖的框架，用于对随机偏微分方程（SPDEs）相关的解算子进行不确定性量化。尽管随机偏微分方程在建模不确定性下的复杂物理系统中扮演着核心角色，但其实际应用通常需要指定模型不确定性的幅度和结构，而这些信息往往是未知的，且难以从含噪测量数据中推断出来。为了应对这一挑战，我们开发了一种随机算子学习框架，该框架能够直接从含噪数据中学习，并同时输出均值解场和不确定性量化结果。所提出的方法被称为随机算子网络，其结构是将深度算子网络与随机神经网络相结合，以建模随机性并实现概率预测。训练过程通过最小化哈密顿型损失函数并优化……
tldr: 该论文提出了随机算子网络（SON），通过将DeepONet与随机神经网络及扩散模型相结合，直接从含噪数据中学习，为随机偏微分方程的解同时提供均值预测和不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Stochastic Operator Network (SON) that combines DeepONet with Stochastic Neural Networks and diffusion models to learn directly from noisy data, providing both mean solution predictions and uncertainty quantification for stochastic partial differential equations.
